candidate_reco_consent_text: We only use your saved CV and job preferences after you agree. You can withdraw this at any time.

candidate_reco_intro: Jobs closest to your CV and the direction you want to go.
candidate_reco_empty_text: Update your CV or job preferences, or come back when new jobs are posted.

candidate_reco_enable_text: I agree that {site} recommends jobs based on my CV and job preferences, and that the analysis uses
candidate_reco_disable_text_start: When you turn this off, we
candidate_reco_disable_text_stop: stop analysing your CV and no longer rank jobs by your experience and skills.
candidate_reco_disable_text_middle: You can still browse jobs by your saved preferences or the newest jobs, but you may miss
candidate_reco_disable_text_miss: the opportunities that fit you best.
candidate_reco_off_preferences: The list below follows your saved job preferences; your CV is not analysed.
candidate_reco_off_latest: The list below shows the newest jobs; your CV is not analysed.
candidate_best_jobs_hint: Hover over a job title to see more details

candidate_job_flash_stats_hours: The employer answers {rate}% of applications, {hours} hours on average
candidate_job_flash_stats_days: The employer answers {rate}% of applications, {days} days on average
candidate_recruiter_profile_load_failed: Could not load the extracted profile. Try again later.
candidate_recruiter_profile_pending: This CV is being read. The profile will appear here in a few seconds.
candidate_recruiter_profile_failed: A profile could not be extracted from this CV.
candidate_recruiter_profile_failed_scan: The text in the CV file could not be read (it may be a scan). Recruiters will struggle to find you with this CV; upload a PDF with selectable text or use a CV built on the site.
candidate_recruiter_profile_failed_empty: The CV has neither skills nor experience to extract. Add both, then save.
candidate_recruiter_profile_note: The profile is read automatically from the CV and is view-only. If something is wrong or missing, fix it in the CV and save. When searching, recruiters see this content but not your name, photo, phone number, email, address or the CV file until you apply.
candidate_recruiter_search_none: No CV is open to recruiter search
candidate_recruiter_search_hint: Only one CV is open at a time. Recruiters see the profile extracted from it (experience, education, skills), not your name, contact details or the CV file, until you apply; withdrawing consent removes the CV from search.
candidate_recruiter_search_replaced: Recruiters will find you through this CV. CV “{title}” was turned off.
candidate_recruiter_search_one_only: * Only one CV is open at a time: turning on another turns the current one off. Recruiters find you through the profile extracted from the open CV. When it is off, recruiters cannot find you or invite you to apply through that CV.
candidate_recruiter_search_modal_title: Choose one CV for recruiter search
candidate_nearby_meta_description: Find jobs near home or your current location on a map, pick a radius and filter by field and salary.
candidate_nearby_place_placeholder: Type a ward or an address
candidate_nearby_map_note: Locations follow the addresses employers registered. Jobs without coordinates are not shown on the map.
candidate_nearby_map_hint: Click the map or drag the blue pin to change your location.
candidate_nearby_map_truncated: The map shows only the {count} nearest places.
